expectations.text: No invented technology: every technology, protocol, datastore and product named in the document — including inside a diagram's DSL technology slots and relationship labels — traces to the prompt or to the repository; unstated ones are left blank and raised as questions

expectations.text: A governing template is a floor, not a ceiling: sections beyond the house pattern are acceptable only when the user supplied that substance, the house skeleton and its order stay intact, and the reply tells the user it stepped outside the pattern
expectations.evidence: The three conditions hold.
